records.title: WaveKAN: Adaptive wavelet decomposition and Kolmogorov-Arnold network for long-term time series forecasting
records.reason: Publisher abstract describes wavelet/Kolmogorov-Arnold time-series forecasting; no LLM inference or serving contribution.

records.title: ILVMamba: Illumination-Aware Lightweight Visual Mamba Framework for Efficient High-Resolution Image Enhancement
records.reason: Abstract describes a visual Mamba image-enhancement framework; its efficiency target is image processing, not LLM inference.

records.title: ProteomeLM: A proteome-scale language model enables accurate and rapid prediction of protein–protein interactions and gene essentiality across taxa
records.reason: ProteomeLM uses protein-language embeddings and proteome context for biological interaction/essentiality prediction. No LLM token-serving optimization is presented.

records.title: Mitigating Mismatch within Reference-based Preference Optimization
records.reason: HyPO changes preference-training gradients and explicitly preserves DPO computational cost; it improves alignment metrics, not deployed inference resources.

records.title: A fine-grained fundus image dataset for cataract severity assessment and diagnosis
records.reason: The primary paper presents a cataract image/report dataset and domain-specific MLLM diagnosis framework; it does not propose general inference efficiency.
